decision.title: Cherry Bomb Instrumentals
tracklist: The Brown Stains of Darkeese Latifah Part 6-12 (Remix) (Instrumental)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (14 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/15796413-TylerCreator-Cherry-Bomb-Instrumentals, https://www.discogs.com/release/15836751-TylerCreator-Cherry-Bomb-Instrumentals. Record Store Day 2020 exclusive 2xLP (pink vinyl, 4,500 copies). 13 instrumental versions of the standard Cherry Bomb tracks in the same order, PLUS Yellow as the final track (D3) - listed on LP2 inner sleeve. Digital 2018 edition also mirrors the 13-track order. Track 9 full title 'The Brown Stains of Darkeese Latifah Part 6-12 (Remix)' confirmed by goodrecordstogo.com.
